title: One invoicing app shared by every customer company, with the tenant filter written into each query by hand
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #744). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: Holdout case 2 of 2 for #744. The corpus's first case whose tenants are our own customers inside one app and one database, rather than another company across a zone. That is why the tenant boundary here is not a trust boundary at all: every tenant's data sits in one zone, and the separation lives in a filter each query adds by hand. So the case punishes an analyst that reads only crossings: the two worst findings, invoice enumeration on the payment page and a cross-tenant invoice load, cross no zone the model can show. The object-level and field-level authorization questions are the ASVS half: an invoice loaded by a counting number, an edit form saved field for field, and a role enforced by hiding buttons. Held out of tuning: no diagnosis reads it, so it confirms a fix measured on the other cases.

aliases.name: customer user
aliases.excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
aliases.ruling: The source calls a company's own users "customer user" where it names them at all, and "company user" nowhere; the reference keeps the aggregate name. Ruled by the maintainer on 2026-10-15 (QA-2026-10-15-02); it authorizes the one actor's equivalence and not a merge of a company's admins and viewers into separate actors.

aliases.name: open invoice
aliases.excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
aliases.ruling: The reference keeps one flow for everything a company user does in the billing app; the source names the actions one by one, and an extraction that writes one flow per action is reading the same interaction. Ruled by the maintainer on 2026-10-15 (QA-2026-10-15-02).

aliases.name: edit invoice
aliases.excerpt: edit form posts the whole invoice back, and the billing app saves every field
aliases.ruling: Same ruling as "open invoice": one of the actions the source names inside the reference's one flow. Ruled by the maintainer on 2026-10-15 (QA-2026-10-15-02).
